review.summary: Round 3 reviews 55b8932, which fixes round 1's F-001 and F-004 as the developer decided. The model-building skill and both server instruction variants now say that a missing create_change_set means this connection can only read, because of the user's role or because the client asked only for read access, and the skill and instruction tests check the new sentences. An empty consent scope, which a role that ROLE_SCOPES maps to no scope gets, is now its own access level: the consent page shows No access, names the user's role, says that the role cannot connect AI clients, hides Approve and the vendor-data note and keeps Deny, and the connections list labels such a grant No access. A backend test stubs that role limitation and checks that the consent API reports an empty scope and approval redirects with access_denied; frontend tests cover the page state and the helper. ADR-015, the AI domain document and the task record the new wording and consent state. Backend ruff check, ruff format on the changed files, pyright and pytest with the PostgreSQL integration suites (1397 passed) pass, as do the frontend format check, lint, 446 tests and build. No new finding. F-005 (refresh accepts scopes beyond the grant, as ADR-015 decided) stays open for the developer's decision.
